## Validation

- [ ] `mix quality`
- [ ] `mix coveralls`
- [ ] Affected acceptance, example, or platform checks

For terminal lifecycle changes, record the real terminal, backend, input,
resize, exit, and restored settings. For other changes, state that this check
does not apply.
